items.comment: The @return is accurate but oddly phrased and inconsistent with the sibling `fromProduct` doc directly above it, which says 'in declaration order'. The clause 'in its product-element order, that is, at indices 0 through `p.productArity - 1`' is padding: every product's elements are trivially at indices 0 through productArity-1, so this doesn't convey real ordering information. Consider matching the sibling doc's simpler 'in declaration order' phrasing, e.g. 'a tuple whose elements are the elements of `p` in declaration order, typed as `m.MirroredElemTypes`'.
Accurate description of the cons-tuple type; tparams are correct.
Accurate description of the extractor, matches `(x.head, x.tail)`.
